entities.summary: Adalsinda or Adalsindis of Hamay was a 7th-century Columban nun from a prominent Merovingian family. She is venerated as a saint in the Catholic and Eastern Orthodox Churches. Her feast day is 25 December, around the date of her death, traditionally said to have occurred "during the solemnities of Christmas".
